idea-plugin.name: CLI Agent Dock
idea-plugin.description:
Run Claude Code, GitHub Copilot CLI, OpenAI Codex CLI or OpenCode in a dedicated tool window of any JetBrains IDE, with no more alt-tabbing to a terminal to talk to your coding agent.

CLI Agent Dock adds a tool window to the right side bar with an embedded terminal that launches straight into your agent's CLI, already in your project directory. It also connects the agent to the IDE: send it the file and lines you are reading, see every file it changes with one-click diffs, and get a notification when it stops to wait for you.

Supported agents

  • Claude Code (claude), the default
  • GitHub Copilot CLI (copilot)
  • OpenAI Codex CLI (codex)
  • OpenCode (opencode)

Switch agents from the dropdown, or run several side by side in separate tabs. Your preferred agent is remembered across projects and restarts.

Features

  • Embedded agent terminal: a real terminal, opened in your project and pre-launched with your agent CLI
  • Multiple sessions: independent, closeable agent tabs per project
  • Named tabs: double-click a tab to name it after the task or branch it is working on; the name is also used in notifications
  • Send context: put @path:lines for the current file and selection into the agent's prompt, ready for your instruction (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+A / Cmd+Alt+Shift+A)
  • Files changed panel: see what the agent created, modified or deleted as it works; click a file to open its diff, or jump to the commit view
  • Approval nudges: a notification when an agent goes quiet in a tab you are not watching, and a system notification when you have switched to another app
  • Esc reaches the agent (e.g. to interrupt it); double-tap Esc to return to the editor, Shift+Esc to hide the dock
  • Keyboard-first: every action is in Find Action and rebindable in Settings > Keymap
  • Finds your install: besides PATH, looks in the usual npm, Homebrew, WinGet, Scoop, Chocolatey and installer locations

Getting started

  1. Install one of the agent CLIs above and sign in (check with e.g. claude --version).
  2. Open the CLI Agent Dock tool window from the right side bar.
  3. Pick your preferred agent from the toolbar or in Settings > Tools > CLI Agent Dock.

Free and open source (MIT). The plugin makes no network calls of its own and collects no telemetry: it only launches the agent CLI you already use. Works on Windows, macOS and Linux. Source code · Report an issue
